fact: UNESCO-IICBA's request for proposals of 14 May 2026 states that Liberia has no formal National EMIS Policy and commissions a consultancy to draft and validate one with the Ministry of Education, paid for from GPE-KIX country support mechanism funds, with the validated policy due by 20 August 2026.
title: Request for Proposal - Consultancy For EMIS Policy Development Support to Liberia and EMIS Data Analytical Support to Eritrea
publisher: UNESCO International Institute for Capacity Building in Africa (IICBA)
